patterns.note: Infinite horizontal text marquees scroll continuously across the screen to create a dynamic, editorial rhythm between static content blocks.
Alternating full-bleed color blocks in deep navy, warm stone, and dark charcoal segment the narrative flow without relying on traditional borders.
Over-sized, tightly-tracked sans-serif headings create a bold, modern editorial aesthetic that elevates the academic brand.
Interactive circular navigation carousels are used for exploring college life categories, breaking up standard rectangular grid layouts.

technique_notes: To recreate the motion system, implement infinite horizontal text marquees using CSS keyframe translations that seamlessly loop duplicate text strings. Pair this with a rotating circular badge ('Click to take the tour') that uses a continuous CSS rotation transform, potentially bound to mouse movement for a subtle parallax follow-effect.
Achieve the premium editorial feel by utilizing a high-contrast color-blocking layout strategy, transitioning smoothly from light stone backgrounds to deep navy sections with crisp, white typography.

design_tokens.type_scale: Dramatic scale contrast with massive, thin-to-medium display headings and highly legible, clean body copy with generous line height.

standout: The design brilliantly subverts traditional, stuffy academic layouts by adopting a high-fashion editorial aesthetic. This is achieved through giant horizontal text marquees, a sophisticated warm-stone and deep-navy palette, and playful circular interactive elements.
